name: linprog
comment: Sig: [x,fval,exitflag] = linprog(f, A, b, Aeq, beq, lb, ub). min f'x s.t. A*x<=b, Aeq*x=beq, lb<=x<=ub. Solved by proximal (Tikhonov) regularization reusing the strictly-convex quadprog active-set: min f'x + (eps/2)||x||^2 (eps=1e-9). At a vertex optimum n active constraints fully determine x independent of the eps*I term, so the regularized QP returns the EXACT vertex (verified across eps 1e-6..1e-10); eps only selects the LP-optimal active set. Returns a column x. Fingerprint (all unique-optimum -> exact): lower-bound x1>=1,x2>=1->[1 1] fval 2, classic max 3x+2y->[4 0] fval -12, bounded->[0 4], box bounds [0,2]x[0,3]->[2 3]. CAVEAT (not fingerprinted): a degenerate optimum (optimal face) returns the min-norm optimal point, which can differ from MATLAB's basic vertex (objective still matches); unboundedness only flagged heuristically. Verified vs MATLAB R2025b. Fixes bugs/optim/linprog (split from constrained-solvers; fmincon remains).
